title: Day N of inventing my way out of homework (Scribe)

beats.say: My little brother has invented something every day to get out of homework.
Day one. A robot dog that eats homework. It ate Dad's slipper. Dad was still wearing it.
Day nine. A pencil drone that does his homework. It drew a mustache on Mom.
Day twenty-three. A clone machine, so a second Leo can do it. It cloned the dog. Eleven times.
Day forty. A time machine, back to before homework. Nineteen eighty-two. They had MORE homework.
Then Mrs. Grimm drops thirty problems. Handwritten. Due tomorrow. And she knows his handwriting.
Invention forty-one. A robot arm to fake his handwriting. It lasted four seconds.
So I showed him Scribe. He wrote one practice page, so it learns his handwriting.
One photo of the worksheet. Scribe reads all thirty and solves them, step by step.
Then it writes them out in HIS handwriting, stroke by stroke, like a real pen.
He prints it. Done before dinner.
Next morning, Mrs. Grimm checks every page. Perfect match.
Now Leo calls it invention forty-two. The first one that ever worked. And he takes all the credit.
